## Georgetown TX Local Information

Georgetown TX is the seat of Williamson County, founded in 1848 and known as the Red Poppy Capital of Texas. Georgetown is located 26 miles north of Austin and 17 miles north of Round Rock along I-35. Population is approximately 83,000 residents (2024). Georgetown hosts the annual Red Poppy Festival each April at Georgetown Square and the historic 1911 Williamson County Courthouse.

Georgetown ISD serves 11,000+ students across 3 high schools (Georgetown High School, East View High School, and a third campus under development), 4 middle schools (Douglas Benold Middle School, Charles Forbes Middle School, James Tippit Middle School, George Wagner Middle School), and 11 elementary schools (Wolf Ranch Elementary, Carver Elementary, Cooper Elementary, Ford Elementary, Frost Elementary, McCoy Elementary, Mitchell Elementary, Purl Elementary, Village Elementary, Williams Elementary, and more).
